coverage.notes: Outcome coverage was 96 departments at all nine dates; valid independent exposure coverage was zero departments because the EEA query returned two monitor points, not department exposure assignments.

blockers: Independent PM2.5 source returned two 2016 station observations, not department-level 1999-2016 exposure for 96 departments.
Required adjusted covariates and population offset were not reconstructable from a usable public author-designated table.
The article does not state the negative-binomial offset; no unannounced model specification was chosen.
